args.text: Can you start a short Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call: when the Superior sync broke on 4 Nov, who found the cause, and when it was resolved. Post it here as a draft.

DRAFT – Sev 1 recap for Thea's exec call (Quarrendon Freight Lines, Superior terminal, 4 Nov 2025)
• Impact: Dock schedule sync stopped at Superior, starting around 6:40 AM local. Tablets hung and drivers backed up at the guard shack. Dana opened the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
• Cause: Samir Patel (on call) found it at 7:17 AM. A deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Recovery: Samir cleared the stuck jobs and Superior got a partial sync around 8:15 AM. Some inbound trailers were still duplicating at that point.
• Resolved: Samir deployed a hotfix and ran the replay script by 2:38 PM. Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly in real time. Thea confirmed from the yard and Dana closed the incident at 2:44 PM.
Note: the channel logs don't state a time zone for these timestamps. Please check that before the call. Postmortem notes aren't in the channel yet.

I posted the draft recap as a reply to your message in #north-team. It's based on the #inc-qfl-sev1 log, which shows the incident on 4 Nov 2025.

- **Broke:** The sync stopped around 6:40 AM local, and you opened the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause:** Samir Patel, who was on call, found it at 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir's hotfix and replay script finished by 2:38 PM, and you closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea confirmed from the yard. A partial sync came back around 8:15 AM, but some inbound trailers were still duplicating then.

The log doesn't give a time zone for its timestamps, so check that before the call. There are also no postmortem notes in the channel yet.

Picking up Dana's recap: add that the culprit was a deadlocked webhook listener and that Thea was on the bridge for about twenty minutes, then put 30 minutes on the calendar for Dana and me tomorrow at 10:00 to walk through it.
